notes: The page is headed "OFFICIAL RESULTS", run 11/27/20; an ES&S summary report of every contest county-wide, party line by party line, each person's lines checked against its Totals by Candidate.

Compiled by the FEC from the states' certified results. The rows for the state and each congressional district, party line by party line (its write-in candidates added into one line). The copy was taken from the one this site fetched for another state.

Linked from the Board's results page (https://www.monroecounty.gov/elections-results); certified twenty-fourth day of November, two thousand twenty. Every contest's lines, Blank, Void, write-ins and a Total in figures and in words.

The certified recap: each Assembly district's figures, party line by party line; the canvassing board's statement is dated Tuesday, December 1, 2020. The county's row is the sum of its Assembly districts.
A row for each county the contest reaches; compared with each county's own recap.

The Board's own archive of final results (https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/BOE/Election-Results): "Final Results of General Election on Tuesday, November 3, 2020"; one page per group of offices (the list of offices is fingerprinted here); county-wide figures by party line, with no blank, void or scattering figure. Federal contests are compared with the Clerk's certified figures.
